name: feynman
description: Executable specs of how software behaves, and the explorer, checker and diffs derived from them.

scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/spec test && bun run --cwd packages/check test && bun run --cwd packages/code test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test && bun run --cwd packages/play test && bun run --cwd packages/examples test
scripts.typecheck: for p in spec check code play cli view examples; do (cd packages/$p && ./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit -p .) || exit 1; done
